findings.claim: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, `apiDeletes.push(deletedEvent)` pushes the resolved value rather than a promise. The later `Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))` therefore does not wait for those deletions.

verifier.reason: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:460-470, the recurring-booking cancellation path uses an unawaited async .forEach callback that awaits calendar?.deleteEvent(...) at line 466 and pushes the resolved value deletedEvent into apiDeletes at line 467 rather than a promise. Consequently, await Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes)) at packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:652 does not wait for those calendar deletions to complete.
